subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling candidate instead?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same approval-copy bug, and this branch still has a native Telegram renderer gap plus a contributor real-proof gate.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram reason propagation and real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the focused diff.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If a sibling PR has broader maintained coverage and stronger proof after its own blockers are fixed, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch only after the canonical fix is selected or merged.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require native Telegram reason propagation and real prompt proof, then use it as the landing path if maintainers prefer the focused diff.
